# Make every Redtail client feel like your only client.

Connect Redtail CRM, and your clients, their families and the facts that matter come into Levitate on their own. Reach each client like they're your only one, and every email, call, card and text is logged back in Redtail.

[Book a Demo](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations/redtail#book-a-demo) [All integrations](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations)

![Levitate](https://www.levitate.ai/nav-logo.svg)+![](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations/redtail.webp)Redtail

Always current.

Contacts, tags and key facts sync from Redtail.

Personal by default.

Nicknames, family relationships and key dates come with them.

Logged in Redtail.

Emails, calls, cards and texts go back to the client's record.

## Reach the right clients without building a list

The tags and key facts you already keep in Redtail come into Levitate ready to use. Send a market update to every retiree, or a birthday note to every client turning 65, without exporting a single spreadsheet.

## You're never on your own

Your Success Specialist turns on your Redtail integration, sets up your tags with you, and stays with you long after launch day. It's the award-winning support behind every Levitate account.

## Levitate's AI knows your clients

Before an annual review, Meeting Prep sends you a brief with the client's key facts, family, your Redtail notes and what you last talked about. AI Email Campaigns use the same details to write each client their own email, and the whole campaign lands in one review grid.

## Follow-up that starts on its own

Review dates and birthdays from Redtail can start an automation, so every client hears from you before their annual review and on the days that matter to them. Set it up once and it runs for your whole book.

## The small details clients notice

Levitate uses the nickname a client goes by instead of their legal first name, knows who's married to whom, and leaves out clients who've passed away. The details that make an email feel personal, and keep it from going badly wrong.

## Everything lands back in Redtail

Emails, notes, calls, handwritten cards and texts sent from Levitate are logged on the client's record in Redtail automatically. Your records stay complete in the system your firm already relies on.
